name: tracker-slice-edit
title: tracker.py edits an existing slice, and a slice keeps its immutable fields once RED or GREEN has run
outcome: A slice's editable fields change through tracker.py after the slice exists, and its immutable fields stay fixed once RED or GREEN has run.
done_when: tracker.py has one edit subcommand for a slice, and tracker.py --help lists it
the edit subcommand changes an editable field on the beads adapter, and a read after it returns the new value. On the files adapter it exits with the refusal code and writes nothing
the edit subcommand refuses a change to an immutable field once RED or GREEN has run for that slice, exits with the refusal code, and writes nothing
the fake adapter passes the same contract test for the edit subcommand as the beads adapter
shared/tracker-usage.md documents the edit subcommand, and tests/test_tracker_usage_doc.py passes
